description: Defines a LogNode implementation that filters log messages to only pass the message content, omitting metadata like priority, tag, and throwable. Useful for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode that passes only the log message, excluding metadata, for simplified logging output.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to only pass the message text to the next LogNode, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
